description: Batch-crops images from a folder and saves cropped outputs to a separate directory.
notes: The publisher uses an opaque Download Monitor file ID instead of a versioned URL. This manifest points to the official file ID currently linked from the product page; if the publisher changes that ID for a later release, url/autoupdate must be updated manually. The publisher does not publish a SHA-256 checksum; this manifest pins the SHA-256 calculated from the current official download.
The publisher specifies Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 3.0; the application's settings file BIC.ini is persisted.
SHA-256 was calculated from the current official download; refresh it if the upstream file changes.
